classification.difficultyReason: Interpret angles measured from different compass directions and convert each direction to compass and true bearings.

content.prompt: Write the bearing of $A$ from $O$ as compass bearings and true bearings.

spec.description: North and east rays meet at O; OA lies southeast. Ordinary source colours are replaced by house black.
spec.mathematics: OA is 46 degrees clockwise from east.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 46-degree angle is visible.

spec.description: North–south line through O and a southwest OA ray, reconstructed in black.
spec.mathematics: OA is 59 degrees west of south.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 59-degree angle is visible.

spec.description: North ray and northwest OA ray; the angle label remains offset right with a leader.
spec.mathematics: OA is 24 degrees west of north.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 24-degree angle is visible.

spec.description: North and west rays at O; OA lies below west.
spec.mathematics: OA is 21 degrees south of west.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 21-degree angle is visible.

spec.description: North and west rays at O; OA lies above west.
spec.mathematics: OA is 28 degrees north of west.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 28-degree angle is visible.

spec.description: North and east rays at O; OA lies southeast.
spec.mathematics: OA is 56 degrees clockwise from east.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 56-degree angle is visible.

spec.description: OA is slightly east of north; its narrow angle has an offset right label and leader.
spec.mathematics: OA is 8 degrees east of north.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 8-degree angle is visible.

answer.worked: The direction is $8^{\circ}$ east of north, so the compass bearing is $\mathrm{N}8^{\circ}\mathrm{E}$. Measured clockwise from north and written with three digits, the true bearing is $008^{\circ}$.

spec.description: North–south line through O; OA is slightly west of south. Angle label is offset left with a leader.
spec.mathematics: OA is 19 degrees west of south.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 19-degree angle is visible.

spec.description: North and west rays at O; OA lies slightly above west. Angle label is below with a leader.
spec.mathematics: OA is 13 degrees north of west.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 13-degree angle is visible.
